name: volatility_contraction_breakout_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP/VWAP programs temporarily pause directional orders during data assimilation windows — post-news absorption, pre-lunch lulls, pre-event waits — creating 3-5 minute stretches where every 5-second bar has below-average range and volume, pushing the 60-second ATR below the 20th percentile of its 10-minute rolling distribution. When this equilibrium cracks, market makers adjusting delta hedges and trapped short-side participants covering wrong-way positions create a concentrated burst of flow visible as a single 5-second bar with range > 1.5× recent ATR and volume > 1.8× 5-minute average. At 5-second resolution we enter exactly that expansion bar rather than waiting for a full 1-minute confirmation, capturing the first 10-20 NIFTY spot points of the breakout leg. VWAP direction filters out mid-session noise: above-VWAP squeezes that break up are institutionally supported; below-VWAP squeezes breaking down confirm selling pressure.

indicators.name: atr_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars × 5s = 60-second ATR. Original used ATR(14) on 1-min (= 14-min window). Compressed to 1-min because we hold 15-90s — we need to detect squeeze at the same timescale as our hold, not at a 14-min scale which would be insensitive to intraday micro-compressions relevant to our trade.

indicators.name: atr_pctile_120
indicators.formula: percentile_rank(atr_12[i-119:i+1]) within rolling 120-bar (10-min) window, per day
indicators.purpose: 10-minute rolling window for session percentile. Original used full-session percentile; a 10-min rolling window is more stable intraday — early-session ATR spikes (opening volatility) can skew a full-session distribution and make genuine mid-session squeezes appear normal. 10-min window keeps the reference local and responsive.

indicators.name: squeeze_count
indicators.formula: consecutive bars where atr_pctile_120 < threshold (resets at day boundary)
indicators.purpose: Required minimum 36 bars (3 min) of sustained low-ATR bars. Original required 10 min of squeeze (10 bars × 1-min); scaled proportionally: our hold is 3-5× shorter than original (90s vs 15-45 min), so squeeze requirement also compresses. 3-min squeeze on NIFTY is sufficient to trap participants and create the overshoot when it resolves.

indicators.name: vol_ratio_60
indicators.purpose: 60 bars = 5-min volume SMA. Detects the expansion-bar volume surge (> 1.8×) that distinguishes a genuine breakout from a drift. Same principle as original's 2× volume surge on 20-bar SMA; 5-min SMA captures a representative intraday volume baseline.

indicators.name: bar_range
indicators.purpose: Expansion bar trigger: bar_range > atr_12 * 1.5 signals ATR regime change. Original used 1.5× ATR threshold on 1-min bars; same ratio applies at 5-second resolution.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume) from day open
indicators.purpose: Cumulative from session open — no scaling needed. Provides directional bias: breakout above VWAP is institutionally supported (buy flow dominant); breakout below VWAP reflects distribution.

conditions: squeeze_count in last 5 bars >= 36 (sustained 3-min squeeze recently ended)
current bar NOT in squeeze (atr_pctile >= threshold)
bar_range > atr_12 * expansion_ratio (expansion bar: range expansion)
vol_ratio_60 > volume_ratio_threshold (volume surge confirms genuine breakout)
buy_ce.confirmation: All 5 conditions simultaneously true at bar close

conditions: squeeze_count in last 5 bars >= 36 (sustained 3-min squeeze recently ended)
current bar NOT in squeeze (atr_pctile >= threshold)
buy_pe.confirmation: All 5 conditions simultaneously true at bar close

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option pts = ~6 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5. A genuine squeeze breakout should not retrace into the squeeze range within 30 seconds — if NIFTY gives back 6 pts immediately, the expansion bar was a false signal (seller absorbed) and we exit.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts = ~12 NIFTY spot pts. NIFTY squeeze breakouts from 3-5 min compressions typically extend 15-25 spot pts on the first leg; 12 pts captures the lower-end median at 1:2 R:R, leaving room for the thesis to be right without requiring a perfect setup.

filters.vix_filter: none (VIX not used; strategy relies on micro ATR percentile which adapts to the prevailing vol regime)
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST; skip first 15 min to allow sufficient session history for stable ATR percentile
filters.volume_filter: vol_ratio_60 > 1.8 on expansion bar (genuine breakout, not random drift)
filters.trend_filter: VWAP alignment required — close > VWAP for CE, close < VWAP for PE

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — squeeze breakout patterns are well-known (TTM Squeeze) but ATR percentile at 5-second resolution with volume surge filter is less commonly exploited on NIFTY index directly

adaptation_notes: Three major changes from the equity original: (1) Squeeze requirement compressed from 10 min to 3 min (36 bars) proportional to the 5× shorter hold time; (2) ATR period compressed from 14 to 12 bars (1 min) to detect micro-contractions relevant to 15-90s holds; (3) ATR percentile window changed from full-session to rolling 10-min to avoid early-session vol distortion. The core concept — low-ATR compression → expansion bar with volume → directional continuation — translates directly to NIFTY because the index experiences the same institutional order-pause dynamics, just at shorter timescales.
weaknesses: NIFTY index volume is noisier than single-stock volume at 5s granularity — vol_ratio threshold may generate false positives during random volume spikes
ATR percentile with rolling 10-min window can misclassify the first 10 min of each session where history is sparse
3-min squeeze minimum may be too short on high-volatility days when 'squeezes' form and break repeatedly without directional follow-through
Stop at 3 pts is tight for ATM options — theta decay and bid-ask noise at 5s may hit stops on valid setups
